reviews.author: JITENDRA PRATAP SINGH
reviews.text:
As someone who’s been riding the Android wave from Galaxy S3 to S24, I wasn’t expecting to be this impressed—but the iPhone 16e blew me away.• Battery? I’ve gone 3 days without charging.• Performance? The A18 chip is buttery smooth—no lags, no stutters.• Camera? The 48MP fusion system takes stunning, true-to-life shots.• Display? That Super Retina XDR screen makes everything look cinematic.Now I find myself wondering why I didn’t make the switch earlier. Everything just works—and works beautifully. This one’s a keeper.
